speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन्मदाश्रयः ।
असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
iast:
mayyāsaktamanāḥ pārtha yogaṃ yuñjanmadāśrayaḥ |
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu ||
english: Hear, son of Pritha, how, with your mind attached to me, practising yoga and relying on me, you will know me completely, without doubt.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते ॥
iast:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ |
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate ||
english: I will teach you this knowledge in full, together with realised wisdom; once you know it, nothing more here remains to be known.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ॥
iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye |
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ ||
english: Among thousands of people, hardly one strives for perfection; and among those who strive and succeed, hardly one knows me as I truly am.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा ॥
iast:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca |
ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā ||
english: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and ego: this is my nature, divided eightfold.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत् ॥
iast:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām |
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat ||
english: This is my lower nature. But know my other, higher nature, mighty-armed one, which is life itself and by which this world is sustained.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा ॥
iast:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya |
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā ||
english: Understand that all beings have these two as their source. I am the origin of the whole world, and its dissolution.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किंचिदस्ति धनंजय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
iast:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiṃcidasti dhanaṃjaya |
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva ||
english: There is nothing higher than me, Arjuna. All this is strung on me, like pearls on a thread.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
iast:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ |
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu ||
english: I am the taste in water, son of Kunti; I am the light of the moon and the sun; I am Om in all the Vedas, sound in space, and the vigour in human beings.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु ॥
iast:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau |
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu ||
english: I am the pure fragrance of the earth and the brilliance in fire; I am the life in all beings and the austerity in ascetics.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ॥
iast:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam |
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham ||
english: Know me, son of Pritha, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the brilliance of the brilliant.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam |
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha ||
english: Of the strong, I am the strength that is free of desire and passion; in all beings, I am desire that is not against dharma, best of the Bharatas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
iast:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye |
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi ||
english: Whatever states of being there are, whether of sattva, rajas or tamas, know that they come from me alone; but I am not in them, they are in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam ||
english: Deluded by these states made of the three gunas, this whole world does not recognise me, who am beyond them and imperishable.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
iast:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā |
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te ||
english: This divine māyā of mine, made of the gunas, is hard to get past; but those who take refuge in me alone cross beyond this māyā.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः ॥
iast:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ |
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ ||
english: Evildoers, the deluded, the lowest of people, whose knowledge is stolen by māyā and who have taken on a demonic nature, do not take refuge in me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ ॥
iast:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna |
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha ||
english: Four kinds of virtuous people worship me, Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise, best of the Bharatas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
iast:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate |
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ ||
english: Of these, the wise one, always disciplined and devoted to the One alone, stands out; for I am exceedingly dear to the wise, and they are dear to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
iast:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam |
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim ||
english: All of these are noble, but I consider the wise one to be my very self; for, wholly disciplined, they rely on me alone as the highest goal.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः ॥
iast:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate |
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ ||
english: At the end of many births, the wise one comes to me, knowing "Vāsudeva is all." Such a great soul is very rare.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
iast:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ |
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā ||
english: Those whose knowledge is carried away by various desires turn to other gods, following one rule or another, driven by their own nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम् ॥
iast:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati |
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham ||
english: Whatever form any devotee wishes to worship with faith, I make that very faith of theirs unwavering.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ॥
iast:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate |
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān ||
english: Endowed with that faith, they seek to worship that form, and from it they gain their desires, which are in fact granted by me alone.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि ॥
iast:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām |
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi ||
english: But the fruit gained by these people of small understanding comes to an end. Worshippers of the gods go to the gods; my devotees come to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम् ॥
iast:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam ||
english: The unwise think of me, the unmanifest, as having become manifest, not knowing my higher nature, which is imperishable and supreme.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ |
mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam ||
english: Veiled by my yoga-māyā, I am not revealed to everyone. This deluded world does not know me as unborn and imperishable.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
iast:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna |
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana ||
english: I know the beings of the past, the present and the future, Arjuna, but no one knows me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप ॥
iast:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata |
sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa ||
english: Through the delusion of the opposites, which arises from desire and aversion, all beings fall into confusion at birth, scorcher of enemies.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः ॥
iast:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām |
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ ||
english: But people of good deeds, whose wrongdoing has come to an end, freed from the delusion of the opposites, worship me with firm resolve.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
iast:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye |
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam ||
english: Those who take refuge in me and strive for freedom from old age and death know Brahman fully, the inner self, and all of action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥
iast:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ |
prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ ||
english: Those who know me in relation to beings, to the gods and to sacrifice, their minds disciplined, know me even at the hour of death.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥
iast:
kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama |
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate ||
english: What is that Brahman? What is the inner self? What is action, Krishna? What is said to be the realm of beings, and what is called the realm of the gods?

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥
iast:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana |
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ ||
english: Who is the lord of sacrifice here in this body, and how, Krishna? And how are you to be known at the hour of death by those who are self-controlled?

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥
iast:
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate |
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ ||
english: Brahman is the supreme Imperishable; one's own essential nature is called the inner self; and the creative offering that brings beings into existence is called action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥
iast:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam |
adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara ||
english: The realm of beings is perishable existence; the realm of the gods is the cosmic Person; and the lord of sacrifice is I myself, here in the body, best of the embodied.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥
iast:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram |
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||
english: Whoever leaves the body at the time of death remembering me alone comes to my state of being; there is no doubt about this.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥
iast:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram |
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ ||
english: Whatever state of being a person remembers when leaving the body at the end, son of Kunti, to that state they go, having always been absorbed in it.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥
iast:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca |
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayam ||
english: So at all times remember me, and fight. With your mind and intellect offered to me, you will surely come to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥
iast:
abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā |
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan ||
english: With a mind disciplined by practice and not straying elsewhere, meditating constantly, one reaches the supreme divine Person, son of Pritha.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितारमणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
iast:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāramaṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ |
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt ||
english: One who meditates on the ancient Seer, the Ruler, subtler than the subtlest, the Sustainer of all, whose form is beyond thought, radiant as the sun and beyond darkness,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाचलेन ।
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक् ।
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥
iast:
prayāṇakāle manasācalena |
bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva |
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak |
sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam ||
english: at the time of death, with an unmoving mind, joined with devotion and the strength of yoga, setting the life-breath fully between the eyebrows, reaches that supreme divine Person.
